candidates.title: BrownoutMoE: Structure-Aware Expert Grouping for Efficient and Accurate LLM Web-based Services
candidates.reason: Structure-aware expert grouping for MoE serving that targets fragmented expert usage and underutilization; reports up to 2.24x throughput improvement with controlled accuracy degradation.

candidates.title: MRAM-MoE: Efficient Inference of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs with MRAM Chiplet-based Accelerators
candidates.reason: MoE inference accelerator using variable-retention stacked MRAM chiplets and on-chip MRAM, with prefill/decode performance modeling and memory-system co-design.

candidates.title: Efficient MoE Inference on Single Consumer-grade GPU with Dynamic Expert Caching
candidates.reason: SMOE hybrid CPU/GPU framework combines dynamic expert caching, prefill pipelining and token-wise decode prefetch for ultra-large MoE on consumer GPUs; reports large prefill gains and support for 671B-class models.

candidates.title: Understanding Inference Scaling for LLMS: Bottlenecks, Trade-Offs, and Performance Principles
candidates.reason: System characterization across 8B–671B models and DP/TP/PP configurations, including reasoning-workload capacity bottlenecks and dense-vs-MoE scaling behavior.

candidates.title: An Efficient Hybrid Sparse Attention with CPU-GPU Parallelism for Long-Context Inference
candidates.reason: Fluxion co-designs sparse attention over CPU-resident KV cache with output-aware budgeting and CPU/GPU scheduling; reports 1.5x–3.7x speedup with small quality degradation.

discovery_stats.axis: forward citations of MoE-Lightning for offloaded MoE inference
